label: public domain in US by publication date
description: True if the work's best-ranked publication date (P577) is before 1978 and at least 96 years before the reference year, so its US term (max. 95 years from publication for pre-1978 works) has expired. False only means this rule does not establish public domain: 1931-1977 works may be public domain for lack of notice or renewal, and later works usually last for life + 70 years. A pre-1978 record release was not legal publication of the song.
summary: New function: public domain in US by publication date
